sloka: सुग्रीवे च अंगदे चैव विधत्स्व मतिम् उत्तमाम् ।त्वम् हि गोप्ता च शास्ता च कार्याकार्य विधौ स्थितः ॥४-१८-५३॥
transliteration: sugrīve ca aṁgade caiva vidhatsva matim uttamām ।tvam hi goptā ca śāstā ca kāryākārya vidhau sthitaḥ ॥4-18-53॥

translations.english: 'O Rama he is my only son through Tara and dear to me. He is young,innocent but strong.He deserves to be protected by you.
